# Jnanaranjan Sahoo

> Full-Stack & AI Engineer based in Odisha, India. I build web apps and production AI systems: LLM assistants, voice agents and computer vision.

I spent a year at Skillablers in Bangalore shipping production AI systems: a real-time voice agent, a self-hosted question-answering assistant and computer-vision features. I'm also building Swaram, a voice AI platform for small Indian businesses, as my own product. I'm AWS Certified as a Cloud Practitioner and an AI Practitioner.

- Core skills: Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS, Cloudflare, LangGraph, RAG, LiveKit
- Languages: English · Hindi · Odia

## Experience

- [Software Engineer — Skillablers Technologies Pvt. Ltd.](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#experience): Jun 2025 — May 2026, Bangalore. Built a real-time conversational voice agent for automated surveys that replies in under a second (LiveKit, Sarvam, Gemini).

## Projects

- [Swaram — voice AI for small businesses](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects): In development · own product. A multi-tenant SaaS that answers business phone calls in Indian languages. I'm building it end to end: FastAPI backend, Next.js dashboard, SIP telephony, background jobs, usage billing and RAG over each business's own data. Pitched at the BuildAI Tech Pitch Sprint, IIT Gandhinagar (2026). Tech: FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL + pgvector, LiveKit, Redis, Razorpay.
- [Drishti — on-premise video analytics](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects): Proof of concept · own product. Plugs into existing CCTV cameras and runs detection on one low-cost edge device, so footage never leaves the site. Designed for warehouses, factories and retail. Tech: Python, Computer vision, YOLO, Edge AI, Docker.
- [Data analysis agent](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects): Personal project. Upload a dataset and ask questions in plain English. A LangGraph agent profiles the data, writes and runs pandas code in an isolated sandbox, and streams back charts and answers. Tech: LangGraph, Gemini, FastAPI, E2B sandbox, Docker.
